advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Strengthen the test to assert each secret's `gh secret set` is fed by its correct matching SSM source param (verify the pairing, not just independent presence).
evidence: tests/unit/test_secret_rotation_runbook.py:20-21: `assert secret in text` and `assert param in text` — checked separately, not as a pair
tests/unit/test_secret_rotation_runbook.py:33: `assert f"gh secret set {secret} --repo navapbc/rebar" in text` — asserts the set command but not the SSM param feeding it

source prose: `during the 2026-09-07 rotation, SSM was current but ... still held their old 2026-08-12 values` (ssm-secret-write-only.md:86-88) — a narrative example, not a contract token read by any non-human consumer
advisory.finding: The regression test asserts only substring presence of each secret name and each SSM param independently; it never asserts that a given secret is paired with its correct SSM source inside the sync command block, so a future edit that mismatches a secret with the wrong `/rebar/prod/*` param would still pass.
merged_from: The assertion `assert "2026-09-07" in text` couples the test to a narrative incident date in prose that has no downstream consumer, making it a wording change-detector: editing the illustrative date breaks the test with no observable-behavior change.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Verify the GERRIT_SSH_PRIVKEY sync command preserves the private key byte-for-byte (avoid `--output text` newline mangling; match the file-based approach in g2p-ci-credentials.md).
evidence: infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md:114-117: `aws ssm get-parameter --region us-east-1 --with-decryption --name /rebar/prod/ci-gerrit-ssh-key --query Parameter.Value --output text | gh secret set GERRIT_SSH_PRIVKEY --repo navapbc/rebar`

infra/runbooks/g2p-ci-credentials.md:105: `gh secret set GERRIT_SSH_PRIVKEY --repo navapbc/rebar < ~/.ssh/rebar_ci_gerrit` — the existing authoritative path installs the key from a file to preserve exact bytes
`--output text` from awscli appends a trailing newline and does not guarantee byte-exact reproduction of a multi-line SecureString value
dropped.finding: The GERRIT_SSH_PRIVKEY sync command pipes `aws ssm get-parameter ... --output text` into `gh secret set`, which for a multi-line SSH/PEM private key appends a trailing newline and can normalize whitespace, producing a secret value that differs byte-for-byte from the authoritative file-based path in g2p-ci-credentials.md (`gh secret set GERRIT_SSH_PRIVKEY ... < ~/.ssh/rebar_ci_gerrit`). A malformed key silently breaks the GitHub->Gerrit Verified vote path.
dropped.suggested_fix: For the SSH-key mirror, avoid `--output text` piping; write to a temp file with restrictive mode and use `gh secret set GERRIT_SSH_PRIVKEY --repo navapbc/rebar < keyfile`, or note explicitly that the key must round-trip unchanged and cross-link the g2p-ci-credentials.md procedure as authoritative.
